caption:
You feel too small to change anything. But what if one life set right could turn a whole age? (Galatians 2:5 devotional)

You feel too small to change anything, so you wait for the majority to move first and stay quiet and small. But God turns a whole age through one life — a single conscience built by His word does more than hundreds of buildings. Paul refused to yield for even a moment so the gospel's truth would remain for you; one candle set right can light a room the darkness thought it owned.
